--AppleScript -- If the content field starts with "--AppleScript" then it will be interpreted as an AppleScript and will be executed.
open location "http://www.rna.nl/tex.html"

--Applescript direct
-- OPEN TeXLive FILE -- Type the name of a file in the TeXLive tree, for example "geometry.sty". This macro will find it and open it.
set q1 to display dialog "Open TeX File" & return & return & "Enter the name, including extension, of the TeX file you want to open." default answer "" buttons {"Cancel", "Open"} default button "Open" set filename_to_open to the text returned of q1
try set file_path to do shell script "/Library/TeX/texbin/kpsewhich " & filename_to_open set theFile to alias (POSIX file file_path) tell application "TeXShop" activate open theFile end tell on error display dialog ("There don't seem to be any files in the teTeX tree with the filename: " & filename_to_open) buttons {"OK"} default button "OK" end try
